product_metadata.title: ElaDeco Artificial Succulent Plants – 6pcs Faux Succulents Unpotted Realistic Fake String of Pearls Plant for Home Wall Garden Office DIY Party Decoration
features: Exquisite succulent plants – 6 pcs artificial succulent plants come in a box. A nice combination of various kind of succulents. They can be matched with other plants and create a different style.

Premium quality succulent set – These fake succulents are made of soft and eco-friendly plastic, odorless and harmless. Artificial plants don’t need special care and suitable for people who like plants, but are not good at taking care of the real one.

Realistic & vivid – These faux succulents are lifelike appearance of living plants like the fake string of pearls and the realistic texture can stand careful appreciation. They can dress up your home perfectly.

Ideal plant set for decoration – These faux succulents allow you to make a glamorous floral set with other different plants. Use them to decorate a wreath, flowerpot or hanging planter. Decorating your desk, table, bookshelf, cupboard and anywhere you like.
Gift selection – Giving the artificial succulent set as unique gift to your family or friends who love succulent. Good for wedding party arrangements, birthday party table decoration.
